githubCopilotPricingCorrections.note: Facts sourced from docs.github.com, not from opencode's model metadata — that metadata is known-wrong or silent on exactly these points. pick-model must apply these when it discovers/refreshes a github-copilot model, not just for the entries already cached below.

fastVariantMultiplier.rule: Any model id ending in '-fast' bills at 2x its non-fast counterpart's costPerMTokUSD (input, cached input, cache write, output all doubled).
fastVariantMultiplier.assumedByAnalogyNote: No individually published rate exists for these two anywhere in GitHub's docs (checked directly, twice) — a live GitHub-staff-unanswered community thread confirms the gap is real. Apply the 2x override but keep provenance 'assumed', not 'measured', and re-check next pricing refresh.

longContextTier.rule: Threshold is input tokens for the request; when exceeded, cost doubles (2x) for both input and output. Applied automatically per-request against a single model id — no separate model variant to select (medium confidence: inferred from table structure, not stated in prose).
longContextTier.everyOtherEntitledModel: Default only — no long-context tier at all. Do not assume one exists for a model not in this list.

dataResidencySurcharge.rule: If the enterprise's 'Restrict Copilot to data residency compliant models' Copilot policy is enabled (off by default, independent of general enterprise data-residency configuration), every request's already-tiered final cost is multiplied by 1.10.
dataResidencySurcharge.activeForUserNote: The account this seed was captured from is a regular enterprise member and cannot see this admin-only policy toggle directly; seeing 'data residency: EU' on the enterprise page does not confirm this specific Copilot policy is on. Treat as an unresolved ±10% band on absolute credit estimates, not a number to bake in — it does not affect model-to-model ranking either way.

ollamaKvCacheAssumptions.note: Every ollama fitFormula.slopeBytesPerToken below assumes THIS config. If OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION or OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE changes on the host, this fingerprint no longer matches reality and every ollama model's slopeSource must be invalidated back to metadata-only until re-measured.

ollama/qwen2.5:7b.tierNote: Fast up to ~30.7k tokens (input+output); spills past that — misses its own advertised 32768 by ~70MB.

fitFormula.note: Never fits usable VRAM at any context — weights alone (8.99GB) exceed the ~5.9GB ceiling. BASE/SLOPE not cleanly fitted since no non-spilled measurement exists.

ollama/qwen2.5:14b.tierNote: Permanently spill-tier on this GPU: measured 62% GPU at 4096 ctx, 40% at 32768 ctx. Recommended: drop — decodeThroughput below shows it also loses on speed to the dedicated slow tier, so keeping it buys nothing.

decodeThroughput.note: prefill 467 tok/s at 7080 input tokens — prefill is not the bottleneck, decode is

fitFormula.note: Not evaluated as a fast (fully GPU-resident) candidate — weights alone (18.6GB) are ~3x the ~6.0-6.3GB usable VRAM ceiling for this GPU. This entry exists for the deliberate slow tier instead; see decodeThroughput and tier below. KV cache is cheap by construction here (headCountKv=4, embeddingLength=2048) — under 1.5GB even at 32k ctx — so KV headroom was never the constraint, weight size was.

ollama/qwen3-coder:30b-a3b-q4_K_M.tierNote: Deliberate CPU/RAM-bound slow tier for doc-review and code-agentic offline fallback (task types the fast tier can't serve). ~2.9-3.4x faster decode than the dense qwen2.5:14b at every measured context because decode cost tracks active params (8-of-128 experts, ~3B active) not resident size (30.5B total). Clears the ~2min-per-500-1000-output-token usability floor; qwen2.5:14b does not at longer context. GPU offload is ~irrelevant to throughput for this model (natural vs forced-CPU differ by ~2%, within noise) — CPU/RAM bandwidth dominates regardless. Capability claim, not a quality one — no eval was run; ships assumed.

longContextTier.note: Threshold published after all — see the top-level githubCopilotPricingCorrections.longContextTier block.

costOverride.reason: opencode metadata inherits non-fast Opus pricing (5/25) but GitHub docs list Opus 4.8 fast mode at 10/50 — double. Absent from the models.dev catalogue, so cost was not sourced correctly upstream. See the top-level githubCopilotPricingCorrections.fastVariantMultiplier block.

github-copilot/claude-opus-4.8-fast.pricingSource: docs.github.com (override) — opencode metadata is WRONG for this model, do not trust costPerMTokUSD directly
